data.content:
The **RecipeHub** Blazor Web App is built and compiles cleanly. Here's what was created:

**Project structure:**
```
RecipeHub/
├── Models/Recipe.cs          — Recipe & RecipeSubmission models
├── Services/RecipeService.cs — In-memory service with 8 seed recipes
├── Components/Pages/
│   ├── Home.razor            — Homepage with category cards (static SSR)
│   └── Recipes/
│       ├── CategoryList.razor    — /recipes — browse all categories
│       ├── CategoryRecipes.razor — /recipes/category/{name}
│       ├── RecipeDetail.razor    — /recipes/{id} — full recipe view
│       ├── StarRating.razor      — Interactive star-rating widget
│       └── SubmitRecipe.razor    — /submit — interactive form
```

**Render mode strategy:**
- Most pages use **static SSR** (read-only content — categories, recipe lists, recipe details)
- Only `StarRating` and `SubmitRecipe` use `@rendermode InteractiveServer` since they require click handlers and form state

**Categories:** Italian (2), Indian (1), Asian (2), Mexican (2), Desserts (1) — 8 recipes total with breadcrumb navigation throughout.
